description: This file contains an abstract test runner class for resource selection logic in the Orleans streaming subsystem, providing methods to test resource selection behaviors.

classes.name: ResourceSelectorTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract base class providing test methods for resource selection logic in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the resource selector cycles through all resources when starting with an empty selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitely
methods.description: Ensures that the resource selector does not produce infinite selections when requesting a large number.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelections
methods.description: Checks that the resource selector does not reselect resources already excluded.
